product_metadata.title: LANGRIA 6 Tier Wire Shelving Unit Organization and Storage Rack with 5 Hooks,Silver
features: STURDY CONSTRUCTION: all metal parts and supports make the unit less likely to wobble or get damaged during shipping and when being used; the maximum weight capacity is 264 lbs

SMART STORAGE: the side hook-rail with 5 hooks and the shelves themselves give you plenty of storage options and feature a sleek and strong wire mesh, being able to store and hold whatever you put on it
ADJUSTABLE FEET: 4 levelling feet keep the unit in place and allow you to balance and stabilise it, accounting for any unevenness on the floor
OUTER FINISH: an all powder-coating matches most décor schemes; the outer finish protects the unit from water and rust, perfect for home and industrial environments

EASY ASSEMBLY: the shelves slide on top of the clips that keep it in place, allowing you to choose your own shelf height. For your safety, LANGRIA recommends that the shelves are flipped the right way to completely fit over and cover the plastic clips
